summary: Digital Brands Group, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing it retained Roth Capital Partners to explore take-private options on August 3, 2026. On August 5, 2026, it disclosed receipt of a proposal from an existing shareholder (net worth >$1B) to acquire all outstanding common stock for $77.58 per share in cash—a 258% premium over the $21.63 share price. The board will evaluate the proposal with its advisor; no decision or timeline set. No assurance of a transaction. Watch for board response, further proposals, and regulatory/process developments; risk-arb hinges on shareholder's financing and board approval.
